text: Why can a static method not reference an instance field?
choices: Instance fields are private by default
The JVM loads static code into a separate area
It is not called on any object, so there is no object whose field it could mean
Static methods run before objects are created
explanation: The question has no answer, so the compiler refuses. The fix is either to make the field static — if it really is one per class — or to create an object and ask that.
